events.title: DevDiary #6: New Water, New Duties
events.summary: New duty: the capsized yachtCentral Tower calls Code Red. A yacht has gone over offshore. Debris on the surface, people in the water, and not everyone got out of the hull. You take the jet ski out, and from there it is on you. Going under means diving beneath the hull and into the flooded cabin. Find them, get the rescue tube on them, bring them up. events.title: Dev Diary #5: A Peek Above the Surface
events.summary: This episode is about the wildlife itself. We have been building out marine life behavior: when, why and how varied species come and go along our coast, how they react to swimmers, and how a lifeguard on duty actually manages danger. Grab the binoculars and keep watch. Anything breaking the surface that looks off is worth a second look.
